# load tsv and prolific raw data
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
```

# load data
```{r}
# load subs
participants_wide = "participant_wide.csv"
participants_wide_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, participants_wide, sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

sub_remove = c("sub-120","sub-131","sub-145")
participants_wide_df = participants_wide_df[!participants_wide_df$participant_id %in% sub_remove,]

L3_plain = "L3_plain.csv"
L3_plain_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, L3_plain, sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
```

# demean columns
```{r}
participants_wide_df = participants_wide_df %>% 
  mutate(
    # age_mean = age - mean(age),
         age_norm = scale(.$age, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE) ,
         Hum_Com_alpha = human_alpha-computer_alpha,
         Hum_Com_epsilon = human_epsilon-computer_epsilon,
         IN_OUT_alpha = ingroup_alpha-outgroup_alpha,
         IN_OUT_epsilon = ingroup_epsilon-outgroup_epsilon,
         Hum_Com_alpha_mean = Hum_Com_alpha-mean(Hum_Com_alpha),
         Hum_Com_epsilon_mean = Hum_Com_epsilon-mean(Hum_Com_epsilon),
         IN_OUT_alpha_mean = IN_OUT_alpha-mean(IN_OUT_alpha),
         IN_OUT_epsilon_mean = IN_OUT_epsilon-mean(IN_OUT_epsilon)
  )

all_df = merge(L3_plain_df, participants_wide_df, by.x = "participant_id")
```

# construct different L3 cov and save
## IN_OUT_alpha_AGE
```{r}
IN_OUT_alpha_AGE_df = all_df %>% 
  mutate(IN_OUT_alpha_AGE = IN_OUT_alpha_mean*age_mean) %>% 
  select(participant_id, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         age_mean, IN_OUT_alpha_mean, IN_OUT_alpha_AGE)
write.csv(IN_OUT_alpha_AGE_df, paste(data_dir, "IN_OUT_alpha_AGE.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
